SMTO-EXE-0112 — The browser tab SMTO was using has closed

GUID: 0520f666-abe9-5602-a3a9-c391b4b881a3
Slug: browser-page-closed
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: browser

What happened

  • The tab SMTO wanted to use was closed, by a person, by the website itself, or by an earlier step. SMTO did not do anything in it.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO: "List your open browser tabs and continue in one that is still open." SMTO needs a tab that still exists before it can read or click anything.
  2. If the page you need is gone, ask SMTO to open a new tab and go to that page's web address again. A closed tab can't be reopened, but the same page can be loaded in a new tab.
  3. If you can see the browser window on the Gateway computer, don't close its tabs while SMTO is working. Closing a tab by hand stops SMTO's next step in that tab.
  4. If the website closed the tab itself after a button was pressed, check on the website whether that action finished before asking SMTO to do it again. Some sites close a window after completing a step, so it may already be done.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows the page you need in an open tab and continues the task.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask SMTO to resubmit a form until you've checked the site for whether it already went through.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Gateway's Playwright page for the requested tab reported is_closed() before the operation ran.

What this means

  • The backend's page object reported closed during revision or operation validation. The retained effect boundary and original session identity govern recovery. Browser page content remains untrusted, diagnostic rendering adds no navigation or model call, and mutations are not automatically replayed.

Why this can happen

  • The backend's page object reported closed during revision or operation validation.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect current tabs and the original action's receipt; a closed page may reflect a previous successful action.

How to fix it

  • PlaywrightBackend.execute and _revision raise page_closed when tab.page.is_closed() is true, before mark() records any effect. Call browser.tabs to choose an open tab_id, or browser.open_tab (optionally with url) to create a new one, then continue there.
  • Use browser.tabs to select an open tab or explicitly open a new tab.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use browser.tabs to select an open tab or explicitly open a new tab.

How to verify the fix

  • An intended open tab is explicitly selected or created before further page work.

What not to do

  • Do not replay uncertain mutations, scan CDP endpoints, or export cookies/passwords/storage.

Technical notes

  • The retained effect boundary and original session identity govern recovery. Browser page content remains untrusted, diagnostic rendering adds no navigation or model call, and mutations are not automatically replayed.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
